films.title: Windstruck
films.overview: Kyung-jin, a police officer who finds herself chasing down a suspected bag-snatcher on her day off. However, the man she catches turns out to be Myungwoo, a passer-by who was himself trying to apprehend the real criminal.

films.title: My Sassy Girl
films.overview: A young man’s world is turned upside down when a female force of nature takes his life by storm in this outrageous and uplifting ode to true love.

films.title: A Year-End Medley
films.overview: A romantic comedy of a young man and woman that is told in the background of hotel 'Emross'. It has stories of people who met each other at Hotel Emross during the New Year holidays. Each one has his own memory to relate and create relationships or just going nostalgic.

films.title: The Classic
films.overview: Ji-hae's friend is having problems expressing her feelings to the boy she loves, so she asks Ji-hae to write e-mails to him in her name. As the boy falls in love with her letters, Ji-hae discovers the story of her mother's romance which is remarkably similar to her own circumstances.

films.title: Cyborg She
films.overview: A lonely university student develops a romance with a beautiful interesting woman, who turns out to be a cyborg from the future.

films.title: Time Renegades
films.overview: A high-school teacher in 1983 and a detective in 2015 join forces through their dreams to change the perilous fate of the woman they both love—30 years apart.
